findings.detail: TD-055's closing note points the reader at the canonical record with `[`open-decisions.md` D12 rule 7](../modules/open-decisions.md)`. The relative path resolves correctly (docs/quality → docs/modules/open-decisions.md), but with no fragment the reader lands at line 1 of a file whose D12 section starts at line 271, and must then locate rule 7 inside D12's table by eye. Since the whole point of this row is to say "the permanent record lives there, not here," the link is the load-bearing part of the entry — a reader who doesn't follow it through to rule 7 is exactly the reader who re-files the stock-management transformation as a defect. This is low, not medium, because the link is not broken and it matches the existing convention in TD-052 ('See [`open-decisions.md` D11](../modules/open-decisions.md)'); it would rise to medium only if the path itself were wrong.
findings.summary: D12 cross-link has no anchor — lands at the top of a 300-line document
